title: Queued stables can get stuck in `PositionManager` after a collateral is sunset
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  After a collateral is sunset, all the orphaned collateral tokens can be withdrawn by the guardian. If users have queued redemptions, their queued stables will get stuck in the `PositionManager` contract, as there will not be any collateral to redeem. One way of allowing users to redeem their stables it setting `redemptionCooldownPeriod` to 0, as this will trigger `_dequeueEscrow()` when `redeemCollateral()` is called.
